source.directorySummary: Implements the `file search` command for workspace content search, defining its CLI contract, executing ripgrep with path/extension/regex filtering and limit/truncation handling, and adapting results for CLI text and web UI.

adapter.ts.sourceSummary: Adapts parsed search params (keyword/ext/path/regex) to handleSearchCommand with workspace root resolution and limit 100, rendering CLI text via searchResultToCliText or Web nodes via renderFileSearchWeb based on params.source.

definition.ts.sourceSummary: Defines the `search` subcommand schema with variadic required keyword argument, --ext/--path/--regex options, and example invocations under the given prefix/alias.

handler.ts.sourceSummary: Executes ripgrep (--json, --line-number, --column, --smart-case, fixed-strings/regex, ext globs, exclusions) against a validated workspace-relative target and parses JSON lines into normalized FileSearchResult with limit/truncation.

summary.value: Implements the `file search` command for workspace content search — defines CLI contract, executes ripgrep with path/extension/regex filtering and limit/truncation handling, and adapts results for CLI text and web UI. Child `renderers/` (complete) provides web rendering and styling with grouped match display, breadcrumb navigation, and timeline integration.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Read-only content-discovery leaf within the workspace file-operations family of the commands aggregation (sibling to tree/view/edit/create/delete/rename, distinct from git/bottom-up/transfer families). Invoked via the centralized file dispatcher fan-out (adapter.ts/handleFile) and relies on shared workspace-root validation and IGNORE/.gitignore filtering; delegates web presentation to child renderers/ for grouped results, breadcrumbs and timeline integration while remaining stateless with no bottom-up lifecycle.

files.adapter.ts: Dispatch-adaptation bridge for the search vertical — resolves workspace root, applies the fixed limit 100, and forks to CLI text (searchResultToCliText) versus web nodes (renderFileSearchWeb in child renderers/) based on params.source, keeping execution in handler.ts presentation-agnostic.
files.definition.ts: Schema/contract entry point for registration through the commands container into the central dispatcher — declares the variadic keyword and --ext/--path/--regex surface and examples, consumed by adapter/handler without owning validation or execution.
files.handler.ts: Pure execution engine for the vertical — owns ripgrep --json invocation with smart-case/fixed-strings vs regex, ext globs and exclusions against a validated workspace-relative target, plus JSON-lines parsing into normalized FileSearchResult with limit/truncation, intentionally decoupled from adapter rendering and renderers/ UI.
